facts.value: South-facing bowl gets lots of sun; avalanche-prone, breakable crust over deep powder, loose rock

facts.value: Bushwhack and sidehill from the snack meadow, then put on crampons and climb the couloir

evidence.fact: After bushwhacking and sidehilling from the snack meadow, climbers don crampons for the couloir.

facts.value: An uncontrolled fall from the upper headwall could be fatal
